evaluation.title: Agent_primitives – tie each app behaviour to the specs that prove it
evaluation.summary: Code shows what an app does today. Code does not show what the app must continue to do, or why. Code does not show which spec proves each required behaviour. When coding agents write most of the code, no one keeps this knowledge. Each new agent session starts without it. The results are concrete. An agent changes a deliberate decision because the decision looks like a bug. An agent proposes an alternative that you rejected before. An agent deletes or weakens the spec for a required behaviour, and the suite stays green. agent_primitives keeps this knowledge in your repository, next to the code.
